transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As we prepare for the October 1 launch of our clinical documentation platform to external customers, I need each of you to identify any legal conditions that must be included in the launch packet before I give final authorization. The platform has cleared its internal engineering pilot with no unresolved performance blockers, and our current launch packet uses our standard software, privacy, product-description, and enterprise-contract templates. Please go ahead and share any conditions from your functional area that need to be addressed.

transcript.text: I need to flag a legal condition before final authorization. My completed license review of the production build identified that module M-17 incorporates an AGPL-licensed library. Under the company's approved proprietary deployment policy, M-17 must be replaced before any external customer access. This result has not yet been added to the launch packet, and this replacement must be completed as a condition of launch.

The launch packet's privacy terms must be revised to match these contractual obligations before final authorization is granted.
